text:
That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
May be able to comprehend with all saints what
is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;
And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.
explanation: Take a moment today to sit quietly with Ephesians 3:17-19. Let the words settle rather than reaching immediately for their meaning. Sometimes the most honest response to Scripture is simply to let it be present.
reflection: What does this verse stir in you today — not what it means, but what it makes you feel?
application: Read this verse once more slowly, and carry one word from it with you through the day.
memory: One word from Ephesians 3:17-19 — let it follow you today.
prayer: Lord, I'm here with Your Word even when I don't have words of my own. Let that be enough today. Amen.
